Former Trump adviser John Bolton pleads guilty to mishandling classified information

Former Trump national security adviser John Bolton has pleaded guilty to illegally retaining classified information. He is accused of sharing sensitive government documents, including notes from intelligence briefings and meetings with foreign leaders, with relatives for a potential memoir. The plea agreement includes a sentencing range from no prison time to up to five years, with a judge to determine the final sentence.
